about.title: About Us
about.metaDescription: Learn about MIT Technique, the photography and yearbook organization since 1885.
about.hero: Since 1885, our staph have crafted a beautiful annual of photographs and prose commemorating each year at MIT.
about.paragraph1: We are MIT's photography, yearbook, and design student organization. Every year, our staph send off our 400 page annual to the publisher in February and release the book in May. As students and alumni of MIT, we take great care to showcase MIT in its truest form, candidly, at its best and at its worst. We know how tough the Institute can be, and we know how rewarding it is to get to the other side.
about.paragraph2: In addition to designing the MIT yearbook, Technique supports the campus photography community by providing equipment rentals and event photography services.

grogo.title: H.R.H. Grogo
grogo.paragraph1: If you hang around Technique often, you'll hear this name being tossed around. You'll also see his beautiful face on all our merch. This is because our mascot is a gorilla and his name is H.R.H. Grogo.
grogo.paragraph2: "But why?" you ask. We don't know either, but H.R.H. Grogo has been there since the beginning, inscribed in the back of the very first Technique, and has been there ever since. We're not quite sure how or when he became a gorilla.

weekly.title: Weekly
weekly.paragraph1: We hold regular meetings at 12pm on Saturday in 4-253. Anyone is welcome to attend. We have photographic equipment for borrowing and often teach various photography and design related seminars at this time.
weekly.paragraph2: During book season, fall term through early spring term, we hold regular meetings during the week where the various editors of each Technique section come in and do work. This is the best time to get involved with the process of crafting a yearbook.
weekly.paragraph3: We also enjoy going on photowalks and different photographic excursions from time to time!

staph.title: staph
staph.paragraph1: Many of our staph are part time (or full time) photographers and/or designers, as well as MIT students and alumni. Most of our staph are free of infection.
staph.paragraph2: It takes no experience to join Technique. Our dedicated staph are committed to helping everyone who's willing to learn, especially when it's about photography or design.

yearbook.title: Yearbook
yearbook.metaDescription: Preserve your MIT memories with the official Technique yearbook.
yearbook.hero: Preserve your MIT memories with the official Technique yearbook.
yearbook.description1: Every year, Technique publishes a 280-page yearbook commemorating life at MIT. Our dedicated staff of photographers, designers, and writers work throughout the year to capture the essence of the MIT experience.
yearbook.description2: The yearbook features senior portraits, candid photography of campus life, coverage of major events, student organizations, athletics, and the unique culture that makes MIT special.
yearbook.preorderHint: Secure your yearbook at the discounted preorder price.

forSeniors.title: For Seniors
forSeniors.content: Seniors who have a picture are highly encouraged to fill out their information on the <seniorBioLink>Senior Bio</seniorBioLink> page. If you do not have a picture, schedule a time <scheduleLink>here</scheduleLink>. Email us at {email} if you have any extenuating circumstances.

release.title: Release
release.content: The yearbook is released late Spring. Preorder copies can be picked up on campus. Please reach out if you require delivery as a graduate or under other circumstances. Accommodations can be discussed and arranged, but are not guaranteed.

seniors.title: Seniors
seniors.metaDescription: Information about MIT senior portrait sessions with Technique.
seniors.hero: Senior portrait sessions open on a rolling basis.

dressCode.title: Dress Code
dressCode.content: There is no dress code for senior portraits. You can show up in a suit, dress, or even your pajamas. We have even had students bring their instruments and pets. We recommend wearing something that you are comfortable being pictured in, since your image will likely be on shelves of your peers for decades to come.

discount.title: Senior Discount
discount.paragraph1: After your senior photo appointment, you will be able to order your yearbook for a special senior portrait only discounted price. This pricing only applies to seniors who attend their appointment.
discount.paragraph2: If you do not wish to get your senior portrait, you are still able to pre-order your yearbook at the pre-order discounted price on our order page.

issues.title: Missed Session or Issues?
issues.content: For all questions regarding scheduling senior portrait sessions, late changes to biographical information, or any other issues, please contact {email}. Technique has a publication deadline for senior portraits, so we unfortunately cannot accommodate any students who miss all scheduled senior portrait sessions. Rest assured that your name will appear in the yearbook in a section that does not feature senior portraits.

translation.title: Translation Disclaimer
translation.content: This website is available in multiple languages for accessibility. While we strive for accuracy, translations may contain errors or variations from the original English version. We retain senior bio information for yearbook publication purposes and historical archives. We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data, but no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

resources.title: Resources & FAQ
resources.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about MIT Technique yearbook, accounts, and services.
resources.description: Find answers to common questions about yearbooks, accounts, and our services.

accounts.title: Accounts & Login
accounts.q1: How do I create an account?
accounts.a1: MIT students can log in using MIT SSO (Touchstone). Clubs can register by clicking 'Club Login' and selecting 'Sign Up' to create a new club account with their official club email.
accounts.q2: What's the difference between student and club accounts?
accounts.a2: Student accounts are for MIT students to manage their senior bio and join clubs. Club accounts are for MIT organizations to manage their yearbook profile, member lists, and candid photos.
accounts.q3: I'm a club - how do I get started after signing up?
accounts.a3: After signing up, you'll need to add at least one MIT student as a leader before your club becomes discoverable. Search for the student by name or email in the onboarding section.
accounts.a4: Clubs can invite MIT students to join. Students will see pending invitations in their profile's 'My Clubs' tab and can accept or decline. Accepted invitations automatically add the student as a member.

yearbook.title: Yearbook & Ordering
yearbook.q1: When can I order the yearbook?
yearbook.a1: Yearbooks are typically available for preorder in the spring semester. Check the Yearbook page for current availability and pricing.
yearbook.q2: How do I submit my senior bio?
yearbook.a2: Log in with your MIT account, then navigate to your profile. You can edit your quote, achievements, and other information that will appear in the yearbook.
yearbook.q3: Can parents or alumni order yearbooks?
yearbook.a3: Yes! Visit the Parents or Alumni pages for information on ordering yearbooks as a gift or for yourself.

clubs.title: Clubs & Organizations
clubs.q1: How do I add my club to the yearbook?
clubs.a1: Register a club account, add a leader, then fill out your club profile with a description, member list, and candid photos. Your submission will be reviewed by the Technique staff.
clubs.a2: Submit high-quality candid photos that represent your club's activities. You can upload up to 3 photos. Avoid posed group shots - we want to capture your club in action!
clubs.q3: Who can manage the club profile?
clubs.a3: The club account owner and designated leaders can edit the club profile. Leaders must be MIT students and are added through the club dashboard.
